name: Gakuen King Bangai Hen -Hidehiko Curry o Tsukuru-
original_name: 学園KING番外編 -日出彦 カレーをつくる-
source:
Several months after collapse of Kunlun island the school building was moved to the mainland and students enjoyed their school lives. It looked like the lawless state of the school was over. However a new trial awaits the students.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-november-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
昆仑岛塌陷几个月后，校舍迁往大陆，学生们开始享受学校生活。看来学校无法无天的状态已经结束了。然而，新的考验正在等待着学生们。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-november-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
